rationale: Extracted shared Scaffold responsibility from Flask and Blueprint; both classes changed inheritance and shed duplicated setup, routing, and decorator responsibilities into shared scaffold code. Mixed behavior changes are present, so only the two existing structurally refactored files are in scope.

Separated I/O-independent App and Blueprint responsibilities into Sans-IO base classes; existing app.py and blueprints.py became I/O-specific subclasses, and the existing scaffold responsibility moved into sansio. Mixed behavior changes are present; ripple-only files and newly created output modules are outside the matching scope.
